contract.title: Say when a search finds nothing
contract.details:
On the search results page of the Driftwood help centre, show the message No articles found and a link to the contact form when a search finds no article.

Today the page is blank and readers think the site is broken. The search box stays at the top of the page so that they can try other words.

criteria.text: Searching for zzqqxx shows No articles found and a link to the contact form, with the search box still at the top of the page.
